device.description: 12-bit 50-200 kSPS fully differential SAR ADC with serial output
device.note: adc121s625.pdf (SNAS294B) p.1 connection diagram, p.2 pin descriptions, p.3 operating ratings, p.5 output coding, p.6 timing specifications and Figure 2, p.7 Figure 3 double cycle, p.17 serial output, p.19-20 power down and short cycling

pages: p.1 (pinout: VREF1 +IN2 -IN3 GND4 CS5 DOUT6 SCLK7 VA8), p.2 (pin descriptions), p.3 (operating ratings: VA 4.5-5.5 V, digital inputs 0 to VA, SCLK 0.8-3.2 MHz), p.5 (binary 2's complement), p.6 (tCDV 100 ns, tDIS 50 ns, tEN 50 ns after the 2nd SCLK fall; SCLK low at CS fall; Figure 2: HI-Z, NULL at the 2nd falling edge, DB11-DB0), p.7 (Figure 3: DB1-DB11 LSB first after DB0, then HI-Z), p.17 (data clocked out on falling edges, read on rising edges)
notModeled: differential analog input (the result is the 0 V code 0x000)
DOUT is enabled tEN (50 ns max) after the 2nd SCLK falling edge, not at CS fall: modeled as two "z" bits then the null bit; tValid 0
conversion clocked by SCLK (16 cycles); the result is available at once
automatic power-down at the end of each conversion / at CS rise, short cycling (CS high early ends the conversion: the frame simply ends)
SCLK frequency limits and the minimum clock rate (capacitor leakage)
variants: pin-compatible replacement for the ADS7817; ADC121S655 is the faster (200-500 kSPS) part with a different frame (own datasheet)
